title.zh: 将莱特省第三众议员选区划为独立工程区并授权为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Constituting the Third Representative District of the Province of Leyte into a Separate Engineering District and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Constituting the Third Representative District of the Province of Leyte into a Separate Engineering District and Authorizing the Appropriation of Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1968/ra_5194_1968.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
Any provision of law to the contrary notwithstanding, the Third Representative District of the Province of Leyte is hereby constituted into a separate engineering district, with its office at the Municipality of Villaba. Provided, That the existing engineering district in the Subprovince of Biliran which is also situated in the Third Representative District, shall remain a distinct and separate entity.
The district engineer for said engineering district shall be appointed in accordance with existing laws.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, to carry out the purposes of this Act. Thereafter, such sums as may be necessary for the same purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 27, 1968.
